name: Churn Solution – Cancellation Flows, Save Offers and Failed Payment Recovery for WooCommerce and Paid Memberships Pro
author: ahmadkhateeb123

sections.description:
Subscription stores lose revenue two ways: customers who choose to cancel, and failed renewal payments that quietly end a subscription nobody meant to end. Churn Solution works on both. This free plugin connects your WooCommerce or Paid Memberships Pro store to Churn Solution, shows a personalized cancellation flow to any customer who tries to cancel so you can offer a pause, a plan switch or a discount at the moment they are leaving, and lets Churn Solution retry a failed WooCommerce renewal payment against the customer’s saved card without the customer having to do anything.

What the free plugin does

  • Shows personalized cancellation flows in your own store when a customer clicks cancel, no code required
  • Captures the cancellation reason, written feedback and a session recording of the flow
  • Keeps subscriptions and orders in sync with Churn Solution, and re-enables its own webhooks if WooCommerce switches them off after failed deliveries
  • Carries out a retry on a failed WooCommerce Subscriptions renewal order when Churn Solution asks for one, charging the saved card off-session, and stands down while WooCommerce has a retry of its own pending so the card is never charged twice
  • Core churn metrics in the Churn Solution dashboard

What needs a paid Churn Solution plan

  • Smart Retries: the schedule that decides when a failed renewal is retried, and on which card
  • Dunning email and SMS to customers whose card expired or was declined
  • Audience segmentation, so different customers see different flows
  • Save offers such as discounts, pauses and extended trials
  • Detailed analytics and A/B experimentation on flows

Churn Solution’s paid plans run either as a fixed monthly subscription or as pay-as-we-save, a share of the revenue the flows and retries actually recover. See pricing for current plans.

sections.installation:
Note: You must have Paid Memberships Pro or WooCommerce installed and activated on your site.

Download, Install, and Activate

  1. Navigate to your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin
  2. search for “Churn Solution”, locate this plugin and click “Install”
  3. Instead, you can manually download the latest version of the plugin, then upload the .zip within “Add New Plugin” Page.
  4. Activate the plugin.

After Activation: Cancellation Flows and Other Configurations

  1. Visit Churn Solution website and either sign up for a new account or log in to your existing account.

  2. Follow the setup steps based on your payment/membership provider:

If your main payment provider is Paid Memberships Pro:
* Connect your Stripe account. Make sure to use the same Stripe account linked to your Paid Memberships Pro.

If your main payment provider is WooCommerce:
* Click “Connect to Churn Solution” to connect it with your created churn solution account
* Connect your WooCommerce store by entering your Consumer Key and Secret. To generate keys: Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API, click Add Key, set the description to Churn Solution, permissions to Read/Write, then generate and enter the keys.
Note: After installing the Churn Solution plugin, visiting the plugin’s page in your WordPress dashboard and clicking on “Connect to Stripe” will guide you through these steps. However, it’s important to note that you will still need to create and publish the cancellation flows on the Churn Solution website separately.
3. Create and publish your first cancellation flow that will be displayed to your customers.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin recover failed subscription payments or send dunning emails?

The plugin does the charging, not the deciding, and it never sends email. On WooCommerce Subscriptions it can retry a failed renewal order against the customer’s saved card off-session when Churn Solution asks it to, and it defers to WooCommerce’s own retry schedule so a card is not charged twice. The retry schedule itself and the dunning email and SMS run in the Churn Solution service on a paid plan, not inside WordPress. On Paid Memberships Pro this plugin covers cancellation flows only.

Does this plugin use 3rd party API?

Yes, Churn Solution make use of these APIs:
1. Koalendar, to enable users of reserving meetings with our team and reaching out easily. Terms of use: https://koalendar.com/terms.
2. Churn Solution SDK, our client sdk is used to render the cancellation flows and save your customers sessions and calculate analytics. Terms of use: https://churnsolution.com/terms-of-use/.
3. Stripe SDK, we include stripe sdk that allow us of taking subscription actions upon your website, for example, when a customer of yours accepts an offer. Terms of use: https://stripe.com/legal/consumer.

Do I need to know any coding to use this plugin?

No, Churn Solution plugin doesn’t require any coding knowledge.

Does Churn Solution handle subscription/membership management

No, Churn Solution relies on other plugins that handles that.

What subscription/membership management plugins that is compatible with Churn Solution

Churn Solution currently supports Paid Memberships Pro and WooCommerce. Retrying a failed renewal payment additionally requires WooCommerce Subscriptions.

What payment gateways at Paid Membership Pro does Churn Solution supports

Currently, only stripe.

Do I need a subscription on Churn Solution to benefit from this plugin

The free plan covers the cancellation flows, the feedback and session recordings, and core churn metrics. Premium features, such as Audience Segmentation, Special Offers, the Smart Retries schedule, dunning email and SMS, and Detailed Analytics, need a paid subscription. The two lists in the description above spell out which side each feature sits on.

Where can I find more information?

For more details, visit our website.
You can also schedule a demo. with our expert team or send your questions through our Contact Us Page.

1.7.0 – 2026-08-27

  • Smart Retries for WooCommerce
  • Security enhancements

1.6.1 – 2026-08-12

  • Fix dunning revenue tracking on WooCommerce when the customer is not logged in

1.6.0 – 2026-08-12

  • Recover automatically when WooCommerce switches off a Churn Solution webhook after failed deliveries, so subscriptions and orders keep syncing instead of going quiet
  • Stop recovering a webhook that keeps failing, so a lasting problem is reported rather than retried forever

1.5.2 – 2026-08-13

  • Limit the resume date on WooCommerce when an end date already exists

1.5.1 – 2026-08-03

  • Improve mode detection

1.5.0 – 2026-07-28

  • Pause and skip are now hidden where they cannot be applied: subscriptions whose original order is still unpaid, and sign-ups that never completed payment
  • Show “Resume” only while a pause is actually running, instead of until the customer resumes it manually
  • Fix the resume date shown when pausing a suspended subscription
  • Require a logged-in user on the plugin’s REST endpoints, and check that a subscription belongs to the caller

1.4.0 – 2026-07-19

  • Customise the text shown to your customers from the Churn Solution admin page (subscription buttons, invoice labels and error messages)
  • Add translation support so the default text can be translated with standard WordPress tooling

  • Support dunning for WooCommerce

1.3.0 – 2026-07-08

  • Add pause and payment wall support for Paid Memberships Pro
  • Add subscription reactivation support for Paid Memberships Pro
  • Additional WooCommerce support
  • Version bundled scripts and styles with the plugin version, so upgrades no longer serve stale cached assets

1.2.7 – 2025-11-06

  • Fix Paid Memberships Pro compatibility

1.2.4 – 2025-07-07

  • Improve the plan view when taxes apply
